body.cap: 10kM.ai received a CES 2026 Innovation Award for its AI-based video production technology. | Image provided by 10kM.ai

body.x: 10kM.ai Co., Ltd. (CEO You Sug Kim) announced that it will participate in CES 2026, to be held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9, as part of the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion.

10kM.ai is a company that develops and operates ‘GemGem Video,’ an AI video production service that automatically generates video content using just a few photos. The service automates the entire video production process, including planning, scripting, shot composition, subtitles, and editing, enabling individuals and companies to create video content easily and quickly.

‘GemGem Video’ is currently undergoing proof-of-concept projects and pilot operations with domestic small and medium-sized businesses, content producers, and brand marketing teams. The company is carrying out AI video automation–based marketing and communication projects with companies in the telecommunications, insurance, retail, and content sectors.

In addition, 10kM.ai demonstrated its technological capability and innovation by being selected for a CES 2026 Innovation Award in the ‘Filmmaking & Distribution, in partnership with Cannes Next’ category.

The ‘Filmmaking & Distribution, in partnership with Cannes Next’ category, in which 10kM.ai was recognized, was newly established for the CES 2026 Innovation Awards. Created by the Cannes International Film Festival to discover next-generation video production and distribution methods, the category drew competition from generative AI video technology companies worldwide, making 10kM.ai’s selection particularly meaningful.

Through its participation in CES, 10kM.ai plans to introduce GemGem Video’s AI-driven automated video generation technology to the global market and seek collaboration opportunities with overseas buyers and partners. At the exhibition site, the company will directly demonstrate the technology’s intuitiveness and production speed.

‘GemGem Video’ is a service in which AI automatically creates a story and video structure when users upload just one to four photos. Without professional editing expertise, users can create brand promotions, product introductions, greeting messages, and event videos, with fast production and low cost highlighted as key strengths.

At present, ‘GemGem Video’ is in the service validation and expansion stage, centered on the domestic market. In the future, 10kM.ai is considering expansion into the United States, Japan, and Southeast Asia. The company said, “Demand for mobile-based short-form content is growing rapidly in these regions, and we expect GemGem Video to be highly competitive.”

The company added, “Along with advancing the B2C service of ‘GemGem Video,’ we plan to expand a B2B SaaS version. Through industry-specific templates and global localization, we aim to strengthen our position as an AI video production platform.”

Incheon Metropolitan City and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority announced that they will establish the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion in the LVCC North Hall at CES 2026, showcasing Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as the city evolves from smart city development into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs—including the 10 companies participating in the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion, Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Award Showcase—the organizations will support the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES. Notably, 14 companies received CES Innovation Awards across 17 categories, marking a record-high achievement and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovation companies.
